title: Lightning Tip Jar
description: Build a minimal app that generates a Lightning invoice, displays a QR code, and listens for payment confirmation. The simplest possible real Lightning integration.
what_you_build: A Rust CLI + simple HTML frontend. User enters an amount in sats, gets a Lightning invoice and QR code, and sees a confirmation when paid.

milestones.title: Set up LDK node on regtest and connect to a local bitcoind
milestones.description: Install LDK, configure a regtest environment using Bitcoin Core, and verify your node starts and syncs.

milestones.title: Generate a BOLT11 invoice and display a QR code
milestones.description: Create a fixed-value or user-entered invoice, then expose it to a tiny frontend that renders both the invoice string and a scannable QR code.

milestones.title: Listen for payment and confirm receipt
milestones.description: Watch the LDK event stream for invoice settlement, then push a small success event over SSE so the frontend can flip from pending to paid in real time.

milestones.title: Polish, write README, and open-source it
milestones.description: Clean up the code, write a proper README with setup instructions, record a 30-second demo GIF, and push to GitHub.

chatbtc_context: I am building a Lightning tip jar using LDK in Rust. I have a regtest environment running.

title: Bitcoin Savings App
tagline: Build vault-based savings with BDK and Flutter
description: Build a Bitcoin savings mobile app with time-locked vaults, savings streaks, and Lightning receive. Uses bdk_flutter for on-chain wallet operations and LDK for Lightning receive.
what_you_build: A Flutter mobile app. Users create savings vaults with lock periods, earn streak badges for consistent deposits, and receive sats via Lightning. Balance displayed in both SAT and NGN equivalent.

milestones.title: Set up bdk_flutter, generate a descriptor wallet, and display a receive address
milestones.description: Initialize a testnet descriptor wallet, persist the seed locally for development, and render the first receive address in a clean onboarding screen.

milestones.title: Build UTXO tracking, balance display, and transaction list
milestones.description: Sync the wallet over Esplora, expose UTXOs and recent transactions through Riverpod, and make the balance screen feel alive with real wallet state.

milestones.title: Implement vault lock periods using OP_CHECKLOCKTIMEVERIFY
milestones.description: Create a savings vault where funds are locked until a future block height. Build the lock and unlock flow so users understand when funds become spendable.

milestones.title: Savings plan UI with streak counter and badge system
milestones.description: Introduce the motivation layer: deposit reminders, a streak counter, and lightweight animations that reward consistent weekly saving behavior.

milestones.title: Add Lightning receive via LDK-node Flutter bindings
milestones.description: Bridge the mobile app into Lightning receive flow so users can top up savings with small payments and watch those sats land inside the app.

milestones.title: Live NGN price feed using a public Binance REST API and real-time SAT to NGN conversion display
milestones.description: Fetch a fresh BTC/NGN price every 30 seconds, normalize the numbers, and make the balance screen speak the language your target users actually use every day.

milestones.title: Push notifications for streak reminders using Firebase Cloud Messaging
milestones.description: Wire in reminders that nudge users back into the app before their streak expires, keeping the savings rhythm intact without adding a backend.

milestones.title: Portfolio card generator and submit to BDP gallery
milestones.description: Add an in-app share card generator. Record a demo video. Open a PR to submit to the BDP BOSS projects list.

chatbtc_context: I am building a Bitcoin savings app in Flutter using bdk_flutter for on-chain wallet operations and ldk_node for Lightning receive. The app targets Nigerian users with NGN price display.

title: PSBT Signer CLI
tagline: Parse, sign, and broadcast PSBTs from the terminal
description: Build a CLI tool that parses raw PSBTs, validates inputs, signs with a descriptor wallet, and broadcasts to the network. A deep dive into Bitcoin's transaction format and signing.
what_you_build: A Rust CLI binary. Input: a PSBT hex string or file. Output: signed and finalized transaction hex, optionally broadcast to mempool.space testnet.

milestones.title: Parse a raw PSBT from hex input and display its structure
milestones.description: Build the parser entrypoint, decode the PSBT payload, and pretty-print its unsigned transaction fields so the CLI feels immediately useful.

milestones.title: Validate inputs and resolve UTXO references via Esplora API
milestones.description: Look up each previous output, compare the fetched amount and script against the PSBT input data, and fail loudly when the transaction context does not match.

milestones.title: Sign the transaction using a BIP-86 Taproot descriptor wallet
milestones.description: Derive the signing key material from your descriptor, apply Taproot tweaking, and produce Schnorr signatures that satisfy the PSBT inputs.

milestones.title: Finalize the PSBT and broadcast to testnet
milestones.description: Finalize witness data, extract the fully signed transaction hex, and optionally POST it to mempool.space testnet from the same CLI flow.

milestones.title: Add HWI hardware wallet signing support (Ledger/Trezor)
milestones.description: Introduce an optional signing path through Bitcoin Core HWI so the tool can hand off PSBT signing to external devices without changing the rest of the CLI.

milestones.title: CLI polish, full test suite, docs, submit as BOSS contribution
milestones.description: Finish the UX layer, add a reliable fixture-driven integration suite, document every command, and package the project as a polished open-source contribution.

chatbtc_context: I am building a PSBT signer CLI in Rust using the rust-bitcoin library. I want to parse, validate, sign, and broadcast PSBTs from the command line.
